PHASE.NAME: UPGRADE_2 Integration Hardening
PHASE.GOAL: Run full autonomy integration verification across self-heal, diagnosis, contract repair, impact analysis, phase progression, pre-commit, resume, and handoff.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: A bounded run can move from action loop to self-heal to pre-commit to completion with persisted evidence.
Agent resume and handoff flows can recover after session interruption without scanning monolithic artifacts.

STEPS.step-1: Run end-to-end self-heal scenario against controlled verification failures.
STEPS.step-2: Verify impact results are available to both MCP and self-heal risk checks.
STEPS.step-3: Verify syn agent resume/status works on active, blocked, and completed runs.
STEPS.step-4: Verify failed pre-commit gates block completion and suggest self_heal.
STEPS.step-5: Verify structured handoff artifacts survive reload and guide next role.

RISKS.RISK: Full integration must prove autonomy without bypassing MyGRACE approval and verification gates.
